title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Scalar Option Work Item
summary: Add a trace-owned RFC 9463 encrypted DNS discovery option helper for code points, scalar lifetime behavior, ADN validation, resolver-address filtering, service priority, and forbidden address-hint SvcParams.
planned_changes:
- Add `EncryptedDnsDiscoveryOptionCodes` and `EncryptedDnsDiscoveryOption` under `Incursa.Quic.Dns`.
- Validate that encrypted DNS options include an ADN and at least one usable resolver IP address.
- Filter loopback and multicast resolver addresses before deciding whether the option is usable.
- Reject `ipv4hint` and `ipv6hint` SvcParam keys.
- Add focused unit tests and requirement-home trace tests.
- Add architecture and verification artifacts and narrow the encrypted DNS discovery planning gap.
verification_plan: Run a focused build for the DNS package, run RFC 9463 encrypted DNS discovery option tests and requirement-home tests, validate core SpecTrace JSON artifacts, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DHCPv6 OPTION_V6_DNR byte-level encoding and parsing.
DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR byte-level encoding and parsing.
Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS option byte-level encoding, padding, and parsing.
Full RFC 9460 SvcParam parsing or encoding.
Resolver cache provisioning and router/forwarder advertisement behavior.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned RFC 9463 scalar option policy floor that later DHCP and RA codecs can consume.
